title: A Small Problem
summary_bullets: Discusses how leaders broadcast different messages to execs, staff, and customers
Warns against using a single tone for all audiences
Argues calm and fear are both contagious depending on the message chosen

title: Lucas' Laws of Project Management
summary_bullets: Project success is defined by solving the problem, not just following original specs
Scope can't be fully known upfront; it becomes clearer as work progresses
Fixed date requires variable scope, and vice versa

title: How Successful Companies Go Blind
summary_bullets: Introduces the concept of 'competence blindness' in successful companies
Explains how firms stop recognizing competence once their environment stops rewarding it
Notes such companies can survive for decades despite this blindness

title: In Defense Of Not Understanding Your Codebase
summary_bullets: Argues that partial understanding of large codebases is normal and often optimal
Contrasts two cultures of programming and defends the less vocal group
Suggests full comprehension isn't always necessary or achievable in large systems

title: Don't Ask What You Want. Ask Who You Want To Be
summary_bullets: Explores Benford's Law showing leading digits in real-world data aren't uniformly distributed
Notes digit 1 appears as leading digit ~30% of the time vs. digit 9 under 5%
Uses the statistical quirk as a metaphor for identity-driven goal setting

title: Beyond Happy Path Engineering: Time
summary_bullets: Part of a series examining resilience assumptions across system components
This installment focuses on time-related assumptions in software design
Encourages engineers to question what happens when those assumptions fail

title: The Depth-First Search Pattern: Exploring Trees And Graphs
summary_bullets: Explains when and why to use depth-first search (DFS)
Covers use cases like pathfinding, reachability checks, and exhaustive exploration
Notes DFS applies to trees, graphs, and graph-representable problems

title: How Do I Deal With My Team Members Who Are Resisting Change?
summary_bullets: Most popular article from the previous newsletter issue
Addresses strategies for managing team resistance to organizational change
Written by Andi Roberts
